method: Read-only source review plus independent Fraction checks through the already-built public API; no native rebuild or benchmark.
reviewed_contracts: Full semantic descriptor comparison and independent origin ownership
Native module checks before dispatch, scalar integer moment contraction and formal-rational arithmetic
Native cache LRU/byte accounting and failure-before-eviction allocation strategy
Builder source identity, revision, used-mask, codec and sidecar guards
Parameter-versus-observed coordinate separation and aggregate-domain promotion
limitations: No general concurrency/MVCC claim; callers serialize mutation/materialization and explicit close.
Descriptor keys are declared identities, not proofs that arbitrary external moment values came from data.
Warm constructor guards still inspect source metadata and hash used-mask/rank arrays; zero fact aggregate calls is not constant-time construction.
Current registered operators remain native CPU polynomial/scalar-moment kernels; no grouped/nullable bank or new CUDA calculus kernel.
